title: Restock a twin jumbo-roll tissue dispenser: stub to the reserve spindle, new roll on the primary, cover locked
instruction: This dispenser is almost empty. Restock it with the new roll so the old one gets used up first, and lock it.
context: Restocking restroom dispensers is a core task of janitors and cleaners (O*NET 37-2011.00; 2,172,500 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023). On a twin jumbo-roll dispenser the nearly used stub is moved to the reserve spindle so it is finished first, and the new roll goes on the primary; each sprung hub only lets a core on or off while its release tab is held, and the cover only closes once its stay is released. The instruction says none of this.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left), heights above the bench top. Dispenser lying on its back, front up: white back plate 30 (x) x 49 (y) x 0.6 cm at x 13.5-43.5, y -24.5 to 24.5, with a 3 cm rim (0.4 cm walls). Two spindles, primary at x 27.5, y 12 and reserve at x 27.5, y -12; each is a grey split hub 3 cm tall: a fixed half (1.5 x 2.4 cm, 0.1-1.6 cm on the -x side of the axis) and a sprung half (1.1 x 2.4 cm, 20 g, 500 N/m, 4.8 cm travel) 5.1-6.2 cm on the +x side, which blocks a 7.5 cm core unless drawn in and pushes a seated core +x against the fixed half. Release tabs: blue 1.4 cm buttons (20 g, 400 N/m, 6 mm travel) on 1.8 cm bosses, primary's at x 15, y 1.5, reserve's at x 15, y -1.5; pressed 4 mm or more, that hub's sprung half draws in. Slide gate: red lever 8 x 1.2 x 0.8 cm (30 g) on a post at x 29, y -21.5, 3.9 cm up, lying over the reserve hub (pointing +y), detents at 0 and 90 deg clockwise (clear). Stub: 12-sided paper ring, 8.3 cm across, 7.5 cm core, 9 cm tall, 150 g, seated on the primary hub. New roll: 23 cm across, 7.5 cm core, 9 cm tall, 0.9 kg, on the bench at x 30, y 40. Cover: smoked shell 30 x 49 x 7.4 cm, 0.5 kg, hinged along the far rim (x 43.5, 3.6 cm up) with a closing spring (0.5 N*m/rad) and a 3 N*m*s/rad damper; it starts open at 100 deg, held by a stay. Stay release: blue 1.6 cm button on a 2.4 x 2.4 x 3 cm grey post at x 25, y -28. Waste bin: dark 11 x 11 x 5 cm open box at x 10, y 40.
scoring: Seated: core bottom within 3 mm of the back plate, its axis within 25 mm of the spindle's middle (0.1 cm -x of the hub axis; any further off, the core wall would sit up on the hub) and within 3 deg of vertical. Points: stub seated on the reserve hub with its sprung half out (drawn in under 3.6 cm) and the gate clear 0.25; new roll seated on the primary hub with its sprung half out 0.3; gate in its clear detent (80 deg or more) 0.05; only with both seated: cover shut (under 1 deg) and latched (the latch clicks under 1.5 deg) 0.3, and no gripper within 2 cm of either roll, a tab or the stay button, with rolls and cover still (under 1 cm/s, 0.25 rad/s) 0.1. Score 0, latched, if the cover swings faster than 0.5 rad/s while unlatched and over 2 deg open, a roll falls 5 cm below the bench, the stub goes into the bin, or the cover comes down within 45 deg onto a core inside the dispenser that is not seated (forced over a mis-seated roll); also 0 if the run ends with the new roll on the reserve and the stub on the primary. Scored at the last step; 1.0 held for 1 s ends the run.
reset_notes: Open the cover to 100 deg and set its stay (press the latch), hold the reserve tab and take the stub off, put it back on the primary (tab held), take the new roll off and lay it at its mark, turn the gate back over the reserve hub.
fidelity: Rigid boxes; rolls are 12-sided rings. Hubs: a fixed half and a sprung slider; the release tab draws it in by a rule, not a linkage. The stub starts welded to its hub until the tab is pressed; seated cores are held by the sprung half only. Spinning is judged from the seat, not simulated. The cover stay and latch are welds: the stay lets go when its button is pressed, the latch closes under 1.5 deg. Gate detents are a spring rule.
